message.content: ```[{"sentence_index": 0, "simpler_statements": ["The statement is not correct."]}, {"sentence_index": 2, "simpler_statements": ["Deposit insurance implements a limit for compensation, the highest compensation limit is 500,000 yuan in people's currency."]}, {"sentence_index": 3, "simpler_statements": ["This is not the statement that 'the part exceeding 500,000 yuan is also fully guaranteed by the deposit insurance fund'."]}, {"sentence_index": 4, "simpler_statements": ["All deposit accounts of the same depositor in the same insurance institution are combined and calculated, the full amount is compensated within 500,000 yuan."]}, {"sentence_index": 5, "simpler_statements": ["The part exceeding 500,000 yuan is legally compensated from the assets of the insurance institution, and is not guaranteed by the deposit insurance fund in full."]}, {"sentence_index": 6, "simpler_statements": ["After the deposit insurance fund management institution compensates, the claim rights of the depositor against the insurance institution are obtained in the same order as the liquidation priority rights."]}, {"sentence_index": 7, "simpler_statements": ["Therefore, 500,000 yuan is the highest limit for the deposit insurance fund to compensate; whether the excess part can be compensated and how much, depends on the asset liquidation situation of the insurance institution, and is not guaranteed in full by the deposit insurance fund."]}]```
